    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3

  {

    "languages": ["it","la"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4

  },
  {

    "reading": "Life's breath hooks through the door of strength — a threshold of cold vitality.",

    "source": "generative",
